name: flutter-mobx-kit
description: Agent toolkit for Flutter + MobX projects: AGENTS.md as the single instruction source, 15 on-demand playbooks (DTO, store, page, use case, API provider, localization, design tokens, tests, Maestro flows), 17 ADRs, a plan-first delivery loop that reads the Jira AC before writing code, and a three-tier testing contract with a happy/failure/edge QA gate.
